title: Record Step Read Data
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input list, $c$ a configuration with $k$ work tapes and state set $Q$, and $s,r\in\mathbb{N}$. The constructed record stores $c$'s state, whether the positional width of $x$ is one, and whether the shifted input-head position is zero. For each work tape $i$, it stores the symbol under that tape's head if $i<r$ and otherwise stores blank; it also records whether each tape index $i<r$ has its head at $-s$ or at $s$. The tag, native-right flag, and input-symbol fields are left at their default values.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration with $k$ Boolean work tapes and state set $Q$, on input $x$
caveat: The supplied context does not define the positional-width function, so its Boolean test is rendered descriptively.
